svg.title: FPV VTX and VRX compatibility checklist
svg.desc: A checklist for matching camera, air-unit/VTX, goggles/VRX, firmware, input voltage, antenna connector/polarization, RF bands, physical mounting, cooling and recording features before purchasing.
svg.text: If you cannot verify a row against the exact manuals, pause before purchasing or powering up.

g.text: Camera output / module and cable supported by this VTX or air unit
Exact goggles / VRX model, product generation and firmware are supported
Input voltage, battery full voltage, regulator output and current are compatible
RF band/channel and transmitter-power settings meet local rules
Antenna connector, polarization, cable and mounting match both ends
Frame dimensions, mounting holes, lens FOV, cable path and prop clearance fit
Cooling / airflow, recording path, DVR card and firmware/update steps are known
Control receiver (ELRS etc.) is separate from the goggles' video receiver (VRX).
